effect_description_eng: Inherited Effect [On Deletion] 1 of your Digimon with the [Ghost] trait gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until your opponent's turn ends.
